ContractsPage._note: Whole-page island. Its only prop is `lang` (in practice it reads langSignal.value). All page DATA is fetched on mount — drive it in isolate via _mocks on the three clients, not props. It mounts ContractsHero/ContractsKpis/ScheduleStrip (page-composition) + ContractTrack + ContractCard (child islands) + shared Skeletons. _mocks keys stub the heavy children/clients so a case can pin loading / error / populated / empty deterministically.

_mocks.contractsClient.list: [] (override per case with a Contract[] carrying server `mood`)
